provenance: Phase 1 provisional CARLA rig assumption for CARLA Autopilot Multimodal. Front-camera intrinsics are derived from the dataset card (800x600, FOV=90). LiDAR-to-camera extrinsics follow a documented standard CARLA-style front rig and must be validated visually before downstream use.
extrinsics_source_label: assumed rig (documented CARLA provisional front rig)
projection_convention_note: lidar_to_camera_extrinsics is expressed in the pinhole camera frame expected by src/perception/lidar_conversion.py, where Z is forward depth, X is image-right, and Y is image-down. With CARLA/UE sensor axes (X forward, Y right, Z up) and identical sensor orientation, the mapping is [X_cam, Y_cam, Z_cam] = [Y_ue, -Z_ue, X_ue] after translating from LiDAR origin to camera origin.
